summary: Betssons Turkiet-exponering via B2B-partnern Realm Entertainment utgör en begränsad men ständigt närvarande risk. Erdogans pågående offensiv mot illegalt spel (2025-2026) är den mest aggressiva någonsin, men Betssons direkta exponering har minskat kraftigt sedan 2017.

legislative: Increased prison sentences for illegal gambling
financial: Biometric ID for all e-payment accounts
technical: GSM lines require full ID validation

scenarios.name: Status quo
scenarios.description: Realm continues via domain switching, Betsson revenue gradually declines

scenarios.name: Realm forced to close
scenarios.description: Betsson loses EUR 50-60M license revenue, 3-4% EBIT impact

scenarios.name: Legal escalation vs Malta
scenarios.description: EU/Malta relations make this unlikely, no precedent

quote.text: Betssons värdering är så låg att affären i Turkiet i princip helt måste dö för att det här ska bli dåligt
quote.author: Richard Bråse

key_points: Erdogan rhetoric high, but Malta license protects
Betsson actively diversifying away from Turkey
conclusion.main_takeaway: Erdogan's offensive is historically aggressive but targets domestic actors, payment systems, and Turkish citizens. Malta-licensed operators like Realm are harder to reach legally. Betsson's Turkey exposure is already so low and priced in that further downside is limited.
